content: {"like":["Values strong, memorable performances from classic Hollywood stars, especially Bette Davis and Joan Crawford;","Enjoys musical numbers and concert performances, appreciating high-quality audio/visual transfers;","Appreciates well-executed extras and behind‑the‑scenes content that add value to a collection;","Favors films that balance over‑the‑top humor with clear, realistic opening sequences and inventive set pieces;","Seeks films that maintain a nostalgic appeal and are recommended by trusted reviewers."],"dislike":["Dislikes overacting, melodramatic dialogue, and exaggerated, cartoonish portrayals that lack realism;","Rejects films with poor production values, graininess, and unrealistic lighting or set design;","Avoids movies that feature unlikable or detestable characters, especially those lacking sympathy;","Criticizes films that are overly loud, chaotic, or have excessive repetition and plot holes;","Disapproves of films that feel outdated, poorly aged, or contain cringe‑inducing dialogue and unsatisfying endings."]}
